title: Business Law RAG AI Assistant
summary: A source-cited assistant that answers business-law questions from a 469-page textbook, with hybrid retrieval, an LLM judge for faithfulness, and a multi-agent mode with human review.

title: ElectroPicks: A Real-time Recommender
summary: An end-to-end recommender on 22.6 million Amazon Electronics reviews: two-tower retrieval, FAISS candidates, and LightGBM ranking behind a live store that reacts to every click.

title: Real-time Bike Demand Forecasting
summary: A complete MLOps system for bike-rental demand: validated data ingestion, scheduled batch prediction, automatic retraining with safe model promotion, and drift monitoring.

title: HealthInsight: A Serverless Health-data Pipeline
summary: A serverless AWS pipeline for 101,766 diabetic hospital encounters: medallion data lake, automated data-quality gates, daily orchestration, analytics, and a readmission-risk API.
